question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Injured**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Injured **means harmed physically, typically involving damage to the body. (शारीरिक रूप से नुकसान पहुँचाया गया, जिसमें आमतौर पर शरीर को नुकसान पहुँचाया गया)

 
 
• **Example**: *The athlete was injured during the game and had to be taken off the field for medical attention.*
 
 
 
• This word appropriately fits in the context of the given passage.

Thus,** option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Efficient **means working well and producing results with minimum waste of time and effort. (समय और प्रयास की न्यूनतम बर्बादी के साथ अच्छी तरह से काम करना और परिणाम देना)
 
• **Inquiring **means seeking information or knowledge by questioning. (प्रश्न पूछकर जानकारी या ज्ञान प्राप्त करना)
 
• **Accidental **means happening by chance or without intention. (संयोगवश या बिना इरादे के घटित होना)
